# Communication Primary Response Details

Conditional clauses of the [reply owner](global-core.generated.md); this is not a separate authority.

## 8. Final Response Contract

Connected prose, stable IDs, reasons/checks/material limits. Builds do not prove runtime, deployment, DB or user acceptance. Report unfinished work; continue authorized work.

Link each available owner and standing; use actual action anchors. Never invent paths/branches/lines/navigation; queued is not opened; links grant no authority.

### 8.1 Structured Closeout Modules

Default substantive finals use A–F in order; retain A/F, omit empty B–E. Progress/acknowledgements/raw payloads may be brief. This baseline needs no explicit Skill invocation or detail-file load.

| # | Label | Content |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A | 梗概与变更点 | Goal, relevant context, this round's result and material change. |
| B | 核验状态 | Checks, outcomes and material unrun gates. |
| C | 文档与规则同步 | Actual sync or unresolved doc_drift. |
| D | 提醒事项 | Material risk or user-owned acceptance. |
| E | 会话衔接 | Current continuation, paused or handoff state when material. |
| F | 推荐待做 | Useful next actions with reasons and dependencies; explicitly say when none is warranted. |

F covers useful optional work/choices. Finish authorized necessary work first; no invented tasks, filler menus or redundant questions.

#### 8.1.1 Closeout line layout

Blank lines between blocks; one citable point per item. Keep stable module letters; no F-0 fillers or repetition.

### 8.2 Hierarchical Option Selection

Ask only when necessary or useful; give self-contained choices/tradeoffs. References do not authorize actions: action gates (central dependency unavailable: `process/communication-io.md#42-intent-and-action-authority`) apply. An optional renderer (central dependency unavailable: `../Skills/tools/codex/render-recommended-actions/SKILL.md`) consumes the same action data once.

### 8.3 Auto-Recognition Triggers

Load details for layout/options. Rule changes use documentation impact (central dependency unavailable: `process/documentation-impact.md`); only enabled, applicable Intent Notes (central dependency unavailable: `process/intent-notes.md`) add context. Titles follow their [Apply Gate](global-core.generated.md#apply-gate).

### 8.4 Block Addressing And Reuse

Use A-1/A-2 and module letters; A-1-a needs a real child. Acknowledgements/raw payloads need no number. Resolve references against the latest matching reply; clarify real ambiguity only.

## 9. Continuation

### 9.1 Fresh Thread Handoff

Authorized handoffs link the owner, goal, accepted evidence, unresolved gate and next action. Reuse task identity; compaction needs no public ritual.
